clues: This city is in the north-west part of Mexico. Its state is Sonora, a land in that same far corner.
Summer heat here has hit almost 50 degrees. That makes it one of the hottest cities in the whole country.
In the past, folks here used a much shorter name: Pitic. Two long old names both ended with that word.
Cars are the main thing made in this city. Its car plants have led its growth since the 1980s.
This is the capital city of Sonora. It is also the largest city in that state.
